title: suggest_analysis_steps: inspect the dataset and emit next-step suggestions
description: Analyze the dataset schema, column types, and missing values to produce a list of recommended analysis next steps. Does not modify the data. Use when the user asks for help on what to do next.
rag_note: Takes no parameters. Returns the original dataset unchanged. Suggestions are deterministic based on column types and missing value patterns. Should be used before deeper analysis, not after.
